property_summary: For any caller funded with the 10-wei ticket price and any block environment, play() with exactly 10 wei must not revert (in C the pot is credited before a winning payout so pot - FEE is computable), whereas mutant M reverts on a first winning play because it computes 0 - 1 before crediting the pot.
change_summary: Move `pot += msg.value;` to the end of the function so the credit happens after the payout and reset, leaving a different final pot value.
